notes: USB manufacturer MOONDROP, product string DAWN PRO2 without a space; read from PnP and hid.enumerate() on a PC without opening the device (dac-lab:devices/moondrop-dawn-pro-2.md)

advBeta's WalkPlay row 'DAWN PRO 2' (with a space, SchemeNo15) is a different route; the USB name DAWN PRO2 selects the Moondrop route (advbeta-reddit-astra@39c16e3:android/core/src/main/kotlin/io/github/chronosauros/contour/core/native/MoondropCatalog.kt:56,81)
the vendor tool MOONDROP Hub (WebHID) matches by pid: default vendorId 13784 = 0x35D8, productId 285 = 0x011D (scope-moondrop.md:50)

audio interface MI_01; HID interface 0, usage page 0x0C usage 0x01 (Consumer Control); one 92-byte descriptor collection; reports 0x03 Input 2 B, 0x4B Input and Output 64 B with id (vendor page 0xFF01), 0x54 Input and Output 64 B; read-only, nothing sent (run:2026-10-21-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-01)

the vendor tuning config is switched on and off by holding both volume buttons for 2 s (LED orange on, red off) and is off by default after every replug (product page); whether register 0x0F carries that state is not known (scope-moondrop.md:53-55,67)
frame after report id 0x4B: OP CMD LEN payload; OP read 0x80, write 0x01; values Q8.8 int16 little-endian; band biquads computed at 96 kHz (scope-moondrop.md:34-40)
never send 01 05 01 04 (flash clear) or 01 FF (firmware upgrade) (scope-moondrop.md:130)
gain -18..12 is the MOONDROP Hub's class default for this model (devicePEQ +-12, another tool +-10); the edges need a capture
the unit tested keeps its active EQ on bank 9 and ignores the index switch 01 0F 01 07; Contour writes the Hub's sequence and verifies by reading the eight bands back, whatever bank the unit reports
pre-gain 0x23 (-128..0 dB) is the preamp; the Global Gain register 0x03 (-18..0 dB) is read only because the unit ignores a write; hardware volume (100 steps, buttons) is out of scope

reset.src: MDHUB clearFlash (01 05 01 04) has no caller in the main bundle or the page chunk and the English locale has no reset string; not on the product page (scope-moondrop.md:68,91-95)

hwVolume.src: buttons only: the vendor tool has no deviceVolume feature for this model, 100 hardware steps on the product page; Windows UAC volume works but no vendor software uses it; owner question 2 (scope-moondrop.md:66,97-102,200-201)

rangesAccepted.note: Eight PK bands (20-20000 Hz, gain 0 / -3 / -5 dB, Q 0.707-2.0) were read from the unit and the Hub's sequence was written and read back; the gain and Q edges were not tested.

acoustic.note: At a 48 kHz DSP: PK mix within 0.082 dB, shelves within 0.044 dB (the register plays Q / sqrt2, applied with shelfQScale), LP 8000 within 0.128 dB and HP 100 within 0.081 dB; a 96 kHz DSP fails the LP by 10.8 dB.

persistence.note: Bands written by the vendor tool (Write Cfg) into bank 9 survived a replug; the same check with Contour's own write is not recorded.

settings.note: The unit ignores a Global Gain write (register 0x03), so that row is read only in every build; the EQ write still sends 01 03 02 with the value read just before, as the Hub does, which changes nothing.

tested.beyondVendor: The vendor tool (MOONDROP Hub) offers PK, LS, HS, LP and HP, which Contour offers since 1.6 after the 48 kHz measurement. Contour writes the Hub's sequence to bank 7; the unit tested keeps its active EQ on bank 9, ignores the index switch and takes the writes there.
